dataset_freeze.basis: Explicit owner instruction in Phase 2A request
dataset_freeze.scope: Approval of the selection of 45 questions and their wording; authorization to mark selected questions validated and execute retrieval evaluation using the existing annotations.
dataset_freeze.evidence_annotation_status: AI-authored and AI-checked; human_review remains pending; evidence_complete remains false. No claim of independent owner verification of every page or bundle.

index_verification.origin: fresh index built by production loader/embedding/store code; app index absent at inspection
fresh index built by production loader/embedding/store code; app index absent at inspection

index_verification.scoring: BM25-inspired, k1=1.2, no length normalization; title weight=3
index_verification.candidate_filter: production natural-language parsing, spell correction and boolean filters
index_verification.tie_break: ascending numeric ID after descending production score

mrr_definition: Reciprocal rank of first historical flat relevant page, truncated at 12; misses=0
bootstrap: Macro means; 10000 iid question samples with replacement, same n; percentile 2.5/97.5, linear quantiles; seed 42 reset per system/category. No interval for unanswerable retrieval.
